title: T.J. Wisemen Fart Machine No. 2 (Remote Control)

comparisons.notes: Shopify product data: available, $13.95, barcode 048427112227 (same UPC as T.J. Wisemen RCFM222 / MPN 53420); Fart Machine No. 2, 15 sounds, 100 ft range.

writeup: Woot has the T.J. Wisemen Fart Machine No. 2 remote prank box for $5.99, new. Giggle Novelties sells the same item (matching UPC 048427112227) for $13.95, so this is about 57% less. It plays 15 sounds and the remote works up to 100 feet; the 9V battery is not included. Only a few were left when checked.
